messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on api-gateway-prod (5m avg 12% -> 38%). Pager: @emma (oncall). See: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/abcd/gateway-5xx?from=now-15m

emma (oncall): I'm on it. gathering quick context — is this global or region-specific?

raj (sre): seeing spikes from us-west and eu-west. error class: upstream_timeout and 502 from inference-proxy. No deploys in last 30m.

olivia (eng-runtime): rolling logs now. grep for request_id shows very few entries in the failing window. looks like request_id injection dropped in the routing layer.

kevin (observability): confirmed: traces for affected traces are missing. sampling looks fine, but span tags not getting propagated from gateway -> runtime. also our error logs missing stack traces for many 5xx.

maria (prod-ops): customer impact: several enterprise tenants report timeouts in chat endpoints. Support ticket stream shows increased severity P2s. support-bot, can we notify support?

support-bot: @support-channel Notified. Escalation: create incident bridge if > 30 minutes impact.

emma (oncall): first mitigations: 1) route ~20% of traffic to fallback-tier (model-variant v1.9) via smart-routing 2) temporarily increase gateway replicas (kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=10) 3) enable fast failover at edge for slow upstreams. Doing 1 & 2 now.

raj (sre): scaled gateway to 10. routing change pushed (canary policy -> fallback). Monitoring.

olivia (eng-runtime): deployed a quick patch to re-enable header propagation for request_id on a canary gateway instance. This is not a full fix (need code change in runtime), but should restore traces for some traffic. Patch command: 

```bash
kubectl apply -f /tmp/gateway-propagation-patch.yaml --record
```

kevin (observability): temporary instrumentation request: if runtime team can emit `trace.surface_id` and `request_id` at error log lines, we can tie errors to traces. Can we add a small middleware to log `request_id` and `trace_id` for 5xx within the gateway proxy?

olivia (eng-runtime): I can drop a middleware in the proxy config but it requires a rolling restart; will do in 2-3min. NOTE: logs will be noisy, will set sampling for this patch to 5% first.

emma (oncall): please also add a short-lived metric: `gateway.upstream_latency_5xx_count` and emit with tags `route, model_variant`. we can hook alerts to that while underlying tracing is fixed.

kevin (observability): creating temp dashboard and alert rule now. putting aggregation window at 1m to be responsive.

raj (sre): quick check: backend instance logs show repeated `connect timeout` to runtime pool node-12. node-12 CPU at 98%. scaling runtime pool by +3 nodes.

olivia (eng-runtime): scaled runtime pool and removed node-12 from rotation. applying middleware now (rolling restart).

(2 minutes later)

olivia (eng-runtime): middleware live on 25% of traffic; logs now include request_id for those requests. sample log line: `ERROR gateway: upstream 502 request_id=abcd-1234 trace_id=1a2b3c duration_ms=1203 route=/v1/chat`

kevin (observability): got the lines. stitching traces for those request_ids works. we can see 5xx correlated with runtime GC pauses and some long tail batches.

maria (prod-ops): Customer impact update: support reports reduced error messages from a handful of enterprise tenants but still ongoing for some. sending message to affected tenants: "We're investigating elevated errors, routing to a fallback model and enabling extra logging; we'll update in 30 minutes."

emma (oncall): next actions: - keep fallback routing in place - keep extra replicas - keep temp middleware + low sampling - add an audit ticket for full fix (propagation bug) - handoff in 45m to @raj

raj (sre): I'll take second shift. action items assigned to runtime team for permanent header propagation fix and to infra to improve autoscaling thresholds.

kevin (observability): follow-up: we discovered two observability gaps: 1) request_id sometimes stripped by gateway when a specific header set is present 2) error logs were not structured with trace fields. Adding a stopgap: middleware that injects request_id if missing and emits structured error JSON. Will create PR with TTL (feature flag) and request emergency review.

olivia (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/p/infra/proxy/+/2345 (flag: `obs_stopgap_middleware`). patch includes rate-limited injection and structured error logs. Please review.

support-bot: Support notified customers in wave 1. Templates used: "We’re seeing intermittent timeouts; mitigation underway. ETA 30-60 minutes for resolution."

emma (oncall): summary for handoff: root cause likely request_id header propagation bug + overloaded runtime node(s) causing timeouts and 5xx. Live mitigation: scaled gateway/runtime, enabled fallback routing, deployed temp middleware to restore request_id for sampled traffic, created temp metric/alert, support notified. Open action items: full fix PR review + deploy, expand sampling if safe, reconcile logs for last 60m, post-incident followup doc.

raj (sre): acknowledged. I'll run postmortem template after incident clears. tagging: @kevin to include observability gaps in RCA.

maria (prod-ops): creating incident bridge now and scheduling customer update at +30m.

(Last message)

emma (oncall): baseline: error rate down to 9% from 38% after mitigations. continuing monitoring. handoff to @raj at 15:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
